trivia.fact: NASA's Ingenuity helicopter carried a tiny piece of fabric from the Wright brothers' first airplane to Mars.
trivia.sourceTitle: Pride of the West — and Mars

trivia.fact: Curiosity's wheels have holes that print "JPL" in Morse code into the Martian dirt. It helps the rover track how far it really moved.
InSight's solar panels made about 5,000 watt-hours a sol after landing. By spring 2022, dust cut that to about 500.
trivia.sourceTitle: InSight's Power Generation: After Landing and Spring 2022

trivia.fact: The solar-powered Opportunity rover went silent during a giant dust storm in June 2018.
Martian dust devils sometimes blew dust off the Spirit and Opportunity rovers' solar panels, giving them more power.
trivia.sourceTitle: A Dust Devil on Hilly Terrain

trivia.fact: The Perseverance rover carried the names of more than 10 million people to Mars on tiny chips.
